history.summary: Shri Panchmukhi Balaji Dham is a modern Hanuman temple in Lal Singh Nagar, Phase-2, near Ring Road, Bathinda, run by the Balaji Hanuman Temple Trust (Regd.). It is centred on a large statue of the five-faced (Panchmukhi) Hanuman, and is noted by visitors for its peaceful, religious environment; a bhandara is organised every Tuesday. Rated about 4.6 stars across roughly 200+ Google reviews. No source documents a founding date - treat antiquity claims as UNVERIFIED. town_description: Bathinda is one of the oldest cities in Punjab's Malwa region, historically associated with the 1000 AD-era Qila Mubarak fort and the Razia Sultan legend. It is a major railway junction and a commercial centre for the region's cotton and food-grain trade, sometimes called the 'City of Lakes'. The temple sits in the Lal Singh Nagar locality on the city's Ring Road.
